t: The Evolution mitre saw stand with extension arms is lightweight but sturdy. Quick to assemble, foldable legs make the stand easy to pack away and transport, while the height-adjustable arms are able to support workpieces up to 3m in length. Quick-release mounting brackets allow the removal of tools quickly and also ensure the stand is compatible with almost every make of mitre saw. Rollers and end-stops keep everything in the right place while in use.
